## 0.1.0

* Initial public release.
* iOS: pre-built XCFramework (arm64 device + arm64/x86_64 simulator).
* macOS: pre-built universal XCFramework (arm64 + x86_64).
* Android: pre-built JNI shared libraries (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64).
* Linux: pre-built x86_64 shared library.
* Windows: pre-built x64 DLL.
* Full Dart FFI bindings generated by `package:ffigen`.
* Real-time PCM decode via `IAMF_decoder_open` / `IAMF_decoder_configure` / `IAMF_decoder_decode` / `IAMF_decoder_close`.
